text.p: These are the leading stories in Zambia's newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Governmnent says it will surrender 24 Zairean immigration and government officials who sought asylum here and are refusing to go home to the U.N. high commissioner for refugees.
- The Zambia Congress of Trade Unions urges government to spend more in protecting endangered animal species, including the elephant and rhino.
- The mineworkers union says Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) intends to reduce the number of employees in its police unit in readiness for privatisation.
- The ministry of agriculture says Zambia will face a maize shortfall of over five million 90kg bags this year.
- A leader of a British trade mission says 25 British companies have invested nearly $2 million in Zambia's private sector.
